title: Reduce diagram parser complexity
summary: Extract focused helpers from knowledge diagram parsing while preserving diagram reference and drift outputs.

goal.outcome: Knowledge diagram parser internals are safer and easier to maintain with unchanged diagram-ref behavior.
acceptance: Mermaid node/edge parsing, class membership parsing, file-structure rules, and drift entry parsing have focused helpers where practical.
Pattern construction handles special characters safely and rejects or ignores malformed input predictably.
Diagram-ref validation and package source-root guard tests remain compatible.
Complexity review improves for knowledge parser files or remaining complexity is documented with parser-specific rationale.
non_goals: Do not change canonical diagram YAML/Markdown formats.
Do not move knowledge ownership out of src/knowledge/**.
Do not update unrelated KB content.
verification: rerun complexity review for knowledge files

delta.desired: Parser logic is split into focused helpers with stable outputs.
delta.current: Knowledge diagram parsing has low maintainability, deep nesting, and parser safety findings.
delta.closure: Task closes when diagram tests pass and parser review findings improve.
